EPFO Approves Scheme for Regular Retirement Fund Withdrawals

The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has approved a Scheme for Assured Returns (SWP) that will allow retirees to withdraw their provident fund savings in regular installments. This scheme aims to provide members with a steady and predictable income source while they retain ownership of their retirement corpus. Previously, members had to withdraw their entire provident fund within three years of retirement to avoid their accounts becoming inactive. The EPFO's decision also includes a voluntary savings option for gig workers.
